question: Name the foreign name of the card that has boros watermark? List out the type of this card.
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching foreign_data record.
gold: SELECT DISTINCT T1.name, T1.type FROM cards AS T1 LEFT JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid WHERE T1.watermark = 'boros'
gold0: SELECT DISTINCT T1.name, T1.type FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid WHERE T1.watermark = 'boros'

b.request: List the foreign-language name and card type for every card with a Boros watermark, including cards with no matching foreign_data record
b.sql: SELECT fd.name, fd.type FROM cards AS c LEFT JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.watermark = 'Boros';

c.request:
Name the foreign name of the card that has boros watermark? List out the type of this card.
Also keep rows that have no matching foreign_data record.
c.sql: SELECT f.name AS foreign_name, c.type AS card_type FROM cards AS c LEFT JOIN foreign_data AS f ON f.uuid = c.uuid WHERE LOWER(c.watermark) LIKE '%boros%';

d.request: What are the foreign names and types of cards with a Boros watermark? Include cards that have no matching `foreign_data` record.
d.sql: SELECT f.name, f.type FROM cards AS c LEFT JOIN foreign_data AS f ON f.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.watermark = 'Boros'
